name: Quest Autopilot
summary: Accepts quests and hands them in on its own, pauses while you hold Shift and leaves every reward choice to you.
logoPrompt: A rolled parchment scroll tied with a red ribbon, standing slightly tilted, with a small brass compass resting against it whose needle glows softly
description: **Quest Autopilot accepts quests and hands them in for you, so levelling takes fewer clicks and you keep moving.**
## Features
- Accepts a quest as soon as a quest giver offers it.
- Hands in finished quests and takes the reward when there is nothing to choose.
- Works through quest givers with several quests: finished ones first, then new ones.
- Stops when a quest offers several rewards and tells you in chat, so you pick yourself.
- Hold Shift while you talk to someone to pause it for that conversation.
## How to use
It works right after installing. Type `/qa` (or `/questautopilot`) to see the current state. `/qa off` and `/qa on` switch everything, `/qa accept` and `/qa turnin` switch one half.
## In detail
### Auto accept quests

When a quest is shown to you, it is accepted right away. Quests the game already put into your log on its own are confirmed for you. At a quest giver with a list of quests, it first selects a finished quest to hand in, then a new one to accept. Repeatable quests in such a list are never taken on their own, so your items are not used up in a loop. Click one yourself when you want it.
### Handing in quests

When a quest giver asks whether you are done, it continues if the quest is complete. If the quest has one reward or none, it takes it. If there are several rewards to choose from, it stops and writes one chat line, so the choice stays yours. A quest that asks for gold is never handed in, and neither is one where the game does not say what it costs.
### Pausing with Shift

Hold Shift while a quest or conversation window opens, and the autopilot sits out that whole conversation. A window that opens within 1.5 seconds after the last one closed still belongs to the same conversation, so you can let go of Shift once the first window is up.
### Commands
- `/qa` – shows whether the autopilot, accepting and handing in are on.
- `/qa on` or `/qa off` – switches everything on or off.
- `/qa accept` – switches accepting on or off.
- `/qa turnin` – switches handing in on or off.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail. It reads no combat data, which the Midnight expansion hides from addons.
- The addon is in English.
- Everything is on after installing. Your settings apply to all your characters and are saved until you change them.
- There is no window, only a chat line now and then.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
